name: distorted-glass
title: Distorted Glass
description: A short strip of frosted glass with a rippled surface, pinned over the bottom of a scrolling image feed. It warps and blurs whatever passes underneath and lets scrolling pass through.
use: A scrolling gallery needs a soft frosted fade at its bottom edge so images dissolve into the frame.
avoid: Small copy must stay legible behind it: the glass blurs and warps whatever sits underneath.
a11y: The strip is decorative and lets the pointer through, but it stays hidden below the xl breakpoint, so smaller screens lose it. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A narrow band along the bottom of a photo card looks like rippled frosted glass, smearing the image behind it into soft waves and glowing where the photo is warm. Above it, sharp stacked photos carry white captions.
behaves: Static: nothing moves on its own. Whatever scrolls behind the strip is bent by the glass, and the strip ignores the pointer so the feed keeps scrolling under it.
customise: Only className is accepted; the ripple frequency, displacement scale and glass gradient are fixed in the SVG filter and style block.
weight: light: One static SVG turbulence filter and a repeating gradient; no animation loop.
